item.title: Windows 11 beats Linux for most people — here are 4 reasons why, whether fans like it or not
item.description: Windows 11 offers better app compatibility, hardware support, gaming, and less friction than Linux for most desktop users. Here's why it still wins.

item.title: 'Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth' Xbox Play Anywhere launch date slated for June 3, 2026 — more details on Part 3 coming later this year
item.description: Pre-orders are live now for Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, the remake trilogy's open world middle act.

item.title: 5 more TOP recent ID@Xbox greats — Ever wanted to be an egg, or quarantine potential zombies? This list is for you.
item.description: From zombie admin to pest control, these ID@Xbox titles are great to get you over the January slump.

item.title: This new promo video of the “Windows 11 phone” concept makes the NexPhone look shockingly real — triple‑booting Windows 11, Android, and Linux on actual hardware
item.description: The NexPhone runs Windows 11, Android, and Linux. With a Q3 2026 launch and a $549 price tag, it's a bold attempt to revive the "PC in your pocket" dream.

item.title: Windows 11 now locks Storage settings behind admin rights — and it’s going to confuse a lot of people
item.description: Accessing the Storage settings on Windows 11 now triggers a UAC prompt, giving admins an extra layer of security over system files and device security.

item.title: A popular Grammarly alternative is killing its browser extension unless you pay — blames AI in the process.
item.description: LanguageTool, a popular grammar checker, is killing its free browser extension and opening it only to paid, premium users.

item.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection has a free demo out now for Xbox and PC — carry progress to the full game
item.description: Capcom has released a free playable demo of Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, the next and biggest entry in Monster Hunter's JRPG spin-off series for platforms. Here's what you can expect from the demo.

item.title: WWE 2K26 releases a new gameplay overview trailer — new match types, Start-of-Match actions, and more
item.description: Wade Barrett from WWE provides a breakdown of WWE 2K26's new match types and gameplay improvements in this newly released gameplay trailer.

item.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone devs on making one of the biggest live-service games in the world — "Some teams see launch as the finish line. For us, it’s the starting gun"
item.description: As Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone starts Season 2, its devs joined us to talk how they're handling the challenges of live-service game development.

item.title: The studio behind one of Xbox's best new games plans to return to its iconic franchise, and just opened a second office — "we're not done with it"
item.description: MachineGames' studio director Jerk Gustafsson has promised that it will return to the Wolfenstein franchise, though it may be "later" instead of "now."
